name: Trip sheet takes focus, makes the page inert, and gives it back

planSteps.description: Without clicking any other link first, click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add)
The trip sheet dialog (data-testid=trip-sheet) is open and the keyboard focus is in its entry date field (data-testid=trip-entry)

Run this one JavaScript expression in the page and check that it returns the string "true,true": [document.getElementById('calculator').closest('[inert]') !== null, document.querySelector('[data-testid=trip-sheet]').closest('[inert]') === null].join(). (The section around the calculator is inert, the dialog is not. Check attributes only, do not walk the DOM tree by hand.)

Run this one JavaScript expression in the page and check that it returns the string "true,0,trip-add": [document.querySelector('[data-testid=trip-sheet]') === null, document.querySelectorAll('[inert]').length, document.activeElement.getAttribute('data-testid')].join() (the sheet is closed, nothing is inert, and focus is back on the add trip button)
